title: Price and Recommendation Mentions
summary: This topic loosely groups comments about high price, willingness to recommend, and a few isolated remarks about design or information layout rather than one single coherent issue.

positive.summary: Positive reviews include owners praising the car or its brand enough to recommend it, while one fragment frames the learning curve around information layout as normal adaptation.

negative.summary: The negative review describes a poor design detail that led to breaking expensive sunglasses.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention price or reluctance to recommend, but the short fragments do not provide enough context to tell whether they reflect criticism, personal preference, or another target.

limitations: The sampled fragments mix unrelated subjects, including price, recommendation intent, dealership reference, design detail, and infotainment or information organization.
Several sentiment labels are difficult to interpret from the fragment text alone, especially where wording appears contradictory or lacks surrounding context.
The topic title and summary rely on sparse, short excerpts, so the underlying customer concern may be broader or differently framed in the full reviews.
